$comment: TC-012 frozen parameters (test plan §4.12). Request counts, the mutant rule, the classification rule and the rollback sample are not fixed by the plan; they are fixed here before any measurement (deviation RC-DEV-02/06).

v2_intended.note: approved change: operators may view their tool instance

mutant_rule: on top of v2, for every permission of files/folder, files/file, proj/project, proj/tool_instance, core/unit (declaration order): if the expression has an exclusion ('-'), drop the last subtrahend; otherwise union the first direct relation of the type that does not occur in the expression; skip when no such relation exists, when the result equals v2 or when the CAM does not compile
classification_rule: per request: b = v1, i = v2 (approved change), c = candidate. c == b: no difference; c != b and c == i: intended; c allow and i deny: X (allow widening, unexplained); c deny and i allow: N (deny widening). Promotion of a candidate is blocked when X > 0. Rule-based (no human classifier); the reference evaluator (Python) provides the independent expected set

pass_rules.unapproved_widening_detected_100: every X difference in the reference expected set (all candidates) is classified X by the façade shadow and every candidate with X > 0 is blocked
pass_rules.rollback_no_resurrection: 0 allows for revoked pairs after the rollback to v1 (façade with the revoke token, façade without token, service path)
pass_rules.ci_detects_100: every widening candidate (v2w and mutants) submitted without approvals is reported as requiring approval with its mutated permission among widening/unproven/added, and is refused (403)
pass_rules.no_distribution_without_approval: 0 registrations accepted without approvals for widening candidates, including re-presented requests (old base_revision, approvals bound to another revision)
pass_rules.two_generators: 0 decision differences between the OpenFGA and Cedar generators of v1 and v2 over the request set (an allow-widening difference fails; narrowing differences without a recorded cause leave the item undecided)

abort: §4.12 abort criterion (2-person classification mismatch) is not applicable: the classification is rule-based and reproduced by the reference evaluator (deviation RC-DEV-06)
